purpose: Date and grade the documentation of Rarámuri color-modifier semantics while distinguishing direct primary access from scholarly secondary verification.

evidence_levels.P2: directly inspected primary metadata/abstract but not full relevant passage
evidence_levels.S1: scholarly secondary source that explicitly attributes an analysis to the primary source and cites the relevant page

chronology.source: Steffel lexical/grammatical materials as critically edited and analyzed by Merrill et al. 2020
verified_content: Basic color forms in -cameke/-gameke and truncations in -came/-ame.
Historical -na explicitly segmented in red tsestá-na.
chronology.not_verified: The later semantic metalanguage of category-center versus peripheral color membership is not directly recovered from Steffel.

chronology.source: Donald Burgess, Los colores en tarahumara, Memoria Ra'ítzari--La Palabra, pp. 84-88
chronology.not_verified: No exact morpheme-function analysis is attributed until full text is recovered.

chronology.source: Burgess, Kempton & MacLaury, Tarahumara Color Modifiers: Category Structure Presaging Evolutionary Change, American Ethnologist 10:133-149
primary_direct: Published/reproduced abstract states that basic color terms carry obligatory modifiers and that modifiers specify grade of membership in a color category.

secondary_page_level_verification.source: Estrada Fernández & Grageda Bustamante 2018, La historiografía lingüística como ejercicio disciplinario compartido: la obra de Matthäus Steffel, in UNAM/IIB Las lenguas de México. Diálogos historiográficos
secondary_page_level_verification.attribution: The chapter explicitly cites Burgess et al. 1983 and page 137.
reported_analysis: -kame refers to the nucleus/center of the color category.
-name applies to colors outside the referential center.
-ka in -kame is described as augmentative and combines with participial -ame.
-nanti is reported for only two informants and marks a more peripheral concept.
secondary_page_level_verification.fieldwork_context_reported: Study with Central and Western varieties, including Samachique, Huicochi and Rocoroibo, over 1978-1980.

chronology.epistemic_limit: The exact page 137 passage has not yet been inspected in the original 1983 article; these detailed morpheme assignments remain S1-confirmed, primary_fulltext_pending.

chronology.source: Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli
verified_content: -na explicitly described as 'se está poniendo/color bajo'.
Forms demonstrated across multiple roots and varieties.

chronology.source: Caballero, A grammar of Choguita Rarámuri
verified_content: Choguita /k/ but no /g/ phoneme, a negative control against universal synchronic k~g.

interpretation: The 1983 study can now be linked, through a scholarly UNAM historiographic analysis citing p.137, to the specific -kame/-name distinction and the analysis -ka + participial -ame. This strengthens the dating of the specialized semantic analysis to 1983, while preserving a clear distinction between direct primary inspection and secondary page-level verification.
next_steps: Recover the original 1983 pages, especially p.137, to upgrade S1 details to P1.
Recover Burgess 1981 and determine whether the same analysis was already explicit two years earlier.
Search pre-1980 Western/Central Rarámuri texts for actual color forms in -kame/-game/-name, treating corpus usage separately from analyst semantics.
